requested_property and policy_scope labels are uniform across outcomes (mutual information with answer approx 0)

context_measurements_tokenizer_only.method: handcrafted schema fixtures encoded with the BTRR tokenizer; no model, no training, no seeds
context_measurements_tokenizer_only.margin_policy: 20% over measured worst input, rounded up to a multiple of 64; no truncation permitted

amended_capacity_claim: Transformer reasoning depth/width/heads/FFN and training recipe are held fixed; only lexical representation capacity and sequence capacity are increased to encode the preregistered BTRR state without truncation.

gate_recheck.all_numeric_gates: unchanged_and_still_valid (derived from chance/competence/structure-blind baselines; independent of vocab and context length)
